why: Re-earned, not carried. Independent oracle (written for this row, does not import the engine and does not reuse census_inv_06_09.py) walks EVERY production .py in _archive/hl_stage2 instead of only the Core file, and enumerates each physical .order() send site with its receiver and whether the enclosing module is gated behind the manual --send-one-intent/--confirm-send CLI. Result at the cited tested commit 43731b4f: 5 production files scanned; exactly TWO physical send sites exist engine-wide - Core.py:2703 (automated service path, ungated) and HL_Live_Copy_Service.py:1036 (reachable only through the explicit manual CLI gate, and its status path returns CONFIRM_REQUIRED unless --confirm-send is passed). Exactly one automated send site => the 'no new engine/runtime around Build 3' assertion holds at the whole-engine scope the shipped census never checked. Zero subprocess/os.system/multiprocessing spawns and zero sqlite/psycopg/pymysql/redis connect calls in any production file; no unexpected third-party import (fastapi/uvicorn in HL_Copy_App_SSOT.py are the pre-existing Build3 UI, and that file is the same one restored byte-identical in b64f9a4). Non-vacuous: appending a second .order() site to the Core engine flips the probe to FAIL (2->3 sites), so the predicate can fail. Re-run at the branch head b142cf8 (which differs from the tested commit by +14 lines in Core.py and +21 in exchange_truth.py, both env NAME-alias only) also returns PASS with the single automated site at Core.py:2715 - so the evidence is not stale relative to what would ship. Row-bound in the sense the register demands: it asserts this row's own execution_proof (AST census of .order() sites, imports, process spawns, file writers) at the row's own cited commit, and it fails if the count or the scoping changes - it is not a shared regression sweep, not a substring search, and not a carried boilerplate proof from ENG-INV-01/02. LIMIT STATED HONESTLY: the runtime process count half of the row's execution_proof is NOT claimed here; the probe is static-census only, and the OS process list on this host carries unrelated Hermes/agent processes that cannot be bound to this commit, so no process-count observation is asserted.
